description: Bermúdez, María and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. Seven actual Excel workbooks provide hydraulic-engineering calculations covering pipe flow, pumps, branched systems, water hammer, channel flow, hydraulic sections and backwater curves. Coverage is an undergraduate teaching collection, with each workbook corresponding to a named physical modelling topic. The native descriptors establish computational spreadsheets, not only lecture notes. The source includes a separate instructions document. Software compatibility, numerical formulas and validation beyond the educational context were not inspected. Zenodo supplies the seven computational workbooks and their manual with open access under cc-by-4.0. The computational workbooks are public, but their formulas, compatibility and execution were not checked. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The collection supports teaching through hydraulic calculations.
